title: BlueLife
description: Add realism to your combat with five new melee and ranged weapons
body:
BlueLife brings gritty, hands-on combat to Minecraft!
Craft and wield a new arsenal of realistic tools turned weapons — perfect for players who want a tougher, more immersive survival experience.

🪓 Features:

2 Batons – Simple but effective melee weapons for quick strikes and crowd control.

Combat Knife – Lightweight and fast, ideal for stealth and close-range encounters.

Heavy Hammer – Slow but devastating, capable of crushing anything in your path.

Nail Gun – A unique ranged weapon that fires nails with industrial precision.

⚙️ Survival Reimagined
Use your new weapons to defend your base, take on mobs, or dominate in PvP with a more grounded and realistic combat feel.
